## WeaveServices.localModels property

On-device model access. Optional — undefined when the host has no local models configured or when the applet doesn't have the (future) `localModels` permission. Currently only ASR is exposed; additional sub-namespaces (translation, embeddings) may be added later without breaking changes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
localModels?: LocalModelsApi;
```
